description.value: Our Community Bikes is a Vancouver social enterprise and full-service community bike shop focused on making cycling accessible to all, with a particular emphasis on underserved communities. It sells refurbished bikes and used parts, runs a bicycle recycling hub, and offers DIY repair space and education programs including mechanics courses, youth programming, and 'Pedals for the People' for those facing financial hardship. A touring cyclist will find a staffed repair shop, a well-stocked used parts selection, and a welcoming community-focused environment on Main Street.

bike_parking_detail: 15 racks within 100m: rack (10 spaces, covered) at 6m; rack (5 spaces) at 8m; stands (4 spaces) at 10m; stands (2 spaces) at 16m; stands (2 spaces) at 38m; stands (2 spaces) at 48m; stands (2 spaces) at 60m; stands (2 spaces) at 62m; rack (3 spaces) at 66m; stands (2 spaces) at 67m; stands (3 spaces) at 79m; rack (6 spaces) at 83m; stands (2 spaces) at 93m; stands (2 spaces) at 96m; stands (6 spaces) at 100m. Total: 53 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Our Community Bikes is a full-service community bike shop and social enterprise offering repairs, tune-ups, refurbished bikes, and new/used parts. OSM tag service:bicycle:pump=yes confirms pump availability. The website explicitly describes DIY access nights and workspace for self-repair. Contact details (phone, address) on the website match OSM exactly. No evidence found for e-bike services, rentals, bike boxes, shipping, or other amenities not listed on the site.
concerns: OSM opening_hours do not match the website's seasonal schedule
OSM tag service:bicycle:second_hand=only but website also lists 'New & Used Bike Parts', suggesting new parts are available even if bikes are second-hand only
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Full-service community bike shop with repairs, parts, pump, and DIY access. Excellent resource for a touring cyclist needing mechanical help or parts in Vancouver.
enrichment_extras.notes: Operated by PEDAL Society. Strong social mission focus including programs for equity-seeking groups, youth, and people in financial crisis.

DIY stand.detail: Also DIY access nights and education and workspace for people who want to repair their own bikes

Bike boxes / packing.detail: We can also do bike assembly from box or box up bikes for travel, but we don't have the cardboard boxes that new bikes get shipped in reliably, since we don't sell new bikes.  But if a client was to bring a box themselves, we can definitely box their bike up for them with sufficient notice.

wow_evidence: community bike shop and social enterprise... bicycle recycling hub... DIY workspace access
